players.name: Raleigh/Jeffers
players.summary: Ryan Jeffers fractured his left hamate bone and will undergo surgery, missing an estimated 6-8 weeks with return targeted around July 1. Victor Caratini takes over as Minnesota's primary catcher for the foreseeable future.

sources.title: Ryan Jeffers Diagnosed With Hamate Fracture
Ryan Jeffers Injury: Slated to miss 6-to-8 weeks

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper went 1-for-4 with a double as the Phillies were blanked 1-0 by Cleveland. Cristopher Sanchez threw 8 shutout innings for Philly, but Kyle Manzardo's pinch-hit HR off Jhoan Duran in the 9th proved the difference.

sources.title: Guardians Shutout Phillies in Series Opener

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez drove in a run with a single in the 5th inning but the Giants fell 9-4 to the White Sox. An All-Star candidate hitting .344 on the season, he continues to be San Francisco's offensive bright spot despite the team's struggles.

sources.title: White Sox vs. Giants Box Score May 22 2026

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette went 0-for-4 with a strikeout as the Mets fell 2-1 to Miami. Eury Perez was excellent for the Marlins over 6+ innings; Juan Soto's solo HR in the 1st was the Mets' only offense.

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Kevin McGonigle crushed a leadoff HR on the very first pitch of the game against Baltimore's Keegan Akin — his 3rd career homer and first since April 25. The Tigers dropped their 7th straight, 7-4, but McGonigle delivered near his hometown of Aldan, PA.

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: Crow-Armstrong hit a 2-run HR in the 6th inning (his 6th of the season) and drew two walks, but the Cubs fell 4-2 to Houston for their 6th straight loss. Chicago went 0-for-9 with RISP and has lost 10 of 12.

sources.title: Cubs losing streak reaches 6 as Astros take series opener 4-2

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill missed his second consecutive game with sore ribs suffered when he collided with the wall attempting to rob Shohei Ohtani's HR on May 20. He is expected to avoid the IL and return to the lineup by the weekend.

sources.title: Padres gets encouraging Jackson Merrill update
Padres' Jackson Merrill: Expected to avoid injured list

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Hernandez scored the Dodgers' only run on an Ohtani sacrifice fly in the 7th inning, but Milwaukee won 5-1 behind Logan Henderson and a William Contreras 3-run HR. Hernandez is batting .255 with improving mechanics through 40+ games.

sources.title: Brewers score: William Contreras homers in win over Dodgers

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams did not appear in the Mets' 2-1 loss at Miami on Friday. The Mets held no late lead for a save situation. Through 19 appearances in 2026, Williams has 8 saves and is settling into the closer role for New York.

sources.title: Mets' Devin Williams finding his groove in 2026

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler had an off day as Cristopher Sanchez started Friday vs Cleveland. Wheeler is set to start Saturday and has been elite in his 2026 return from thoracic outlet surgery: 1.85 ERA, 34 K, 39 IP over 6 starts.

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans remains on the 15-day IL with a left elbow impingement sustained May 6. He threw successful bullpen sessions this week and is set to begin a rehab start with Triple-A Omaha on Saturday, potentially returning to the Royals rotation around May 27.

sources.title: Royals' Cole Ragans nears return with Triple-A rehab start

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns' scheduled start was wiped out when inclement weather postponed the Reds-Cardinals game Friday in Cincinnati. The game will be made up as part of a Saturday doubleheader; his next start remains TBD.

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi had an off day as Jacob deGrom started Friday's Rangers-Angels game. Eovaldi (3.62 ERA, 54.67 IP, 9 GS) is slated to start Saturday's game in Anaheim in the series' second contest.

sources.title: Series Preview: Angels close out homestand vs Rangers

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan was not in the rotation for Friday's Dodgers-Brewers game, with Justin Wrobleski getting the nod (L, Dodgers 1-5). Sheehan has a 5.26 ERA through 8 starts, struggling with a 10.00 ERA in the first inning of his outings.

sources.title: Dodgers @ Brewers May 22 2026: Wrobo gets the start

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers was off Friday, with Grayson Rodriguez starting for the Angels against Texas. Detmers has a 5.37 ERA across 11 starts and 60.1 IP in 2026; he is scheduled to start Sunday's finale against the Rangers.

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice went hitless in 4 AB as the Yankees fell 4-2 to Tampa Bay. Gerrit Cole was outstanding in his season debut (6 scoreless IP, 2 H, 3 BB, 2 K), but the bullpen surrendered 3 runs in the 8th inning. Yankees have dropped 5 straight.

sources.title: MLB-best Rays rally late to beat Yankees, 4-2

injuries.name: Raleigh/Jeffers
injuries.note: Fractured left hamate bone; surgery performed in Los Angeles; expected return around July 1 at earliest.

source.title: Ryan Jeffers Diagnosed With Hamate Fracture

source.title: Padres' Jackson Merrill: Expected to avoid injured list
